name: Barnard b
tagline: Un mundo de masa sub-terrestre abrazando la estrella solitaria más cercana — un fantasma centenario por fin real.

facts.label: Precedente
facts.value: Ends a century of retracted Barnard planet claims

history: Barnard b is the confirmation astronomers waited a hundred years for. The star has been astronomy's most haunted — van Zwieten's 1960s 'planets', a decades-long radial-velocity saga and a 2019 candidate all dissolved under better data. Then ESPRESSO's exquisitely stable spectrograph caught a genuine whisper: a world of roughly a third Earth's mass circling every 3.15 days. Too hot for any habitability romance — its year is a weekend — but a real planet around the nearest single star, and proof that even the most scrutinized sky still hides Earths.
source: ESO ESPRESSO — González Hernández et al. (2024)
